It is stacked to the brim with Hunter pet accessories. Staff were very helpful and despite not being able to converse in English, they were extremely attentive and friendly.

Their gift wrapping service is also superb, you wouldn’t want to unwrap it because it’s so well done.

One day, an incident occurred.
My dog's leash broke. 🐕💨
Oh no...
For a dog owner, a large dog's leash breaking is no laughing matter 😂
"Next time, I'll definitely get a leash that I can be sure of!"
So, I rushed to German Pet House Ginza store.
I asked the staff for advice on finding a leash for a large dog, and they very kindly showed me various options.
They listened carefully to what I had to say, and I was able to choose with confidence 😊
As for my dog ​​himself,
"A leash? Forget that, let's go for a walk 🐕"
He probably thinks something like that (lol), but for an owner, a leash is a vital lifeline.
It's truly wonderful to have a store that will kindly offer advice.
Now I can go for walks with peace of mind again.
I hope it doesn't break next time...🤣
Thank you to the staff for your kind assistance!
Good place. Quite expensive but the staff is extraordinary. We did buy couple of treats n a toy for our daughter

It was a very comfortable shop.

For many years, I hadn't been able to find a harness and leash that was both high-quality and well-designed, but
I finally found them at this shop!

The staff who assisted me were simply wonderful.

Their thorough explanations, suggestions to solve my problems, and hospitality were all excellent.

It seems to be a popular item,
and the size and color I wanted were limited, but I really love it.

I'm also very grateful that they rushed to retrieve the item from the warehouse for me.

Thank you very much!

The size is perfect, and my dog ​​seems to like it too.

I'm looking forward to taking him for walks.
I'm so glad that this pet shop sells all varieties of Animonda wet food, which other pet shops have stopped carrying.

2025/Early December Tokyo Trip
Traveling abroad. Besides relaxing and rewarding myself after a hard year, I also wanted to buy souvenirs for my pet. I specifically searched for this store and bought a harness. I originally wanted blue, but it was out of stock. The staff was very kind and explained that white is a versatile color for our pet, and orange would also be very suitable. After buying it and returning home, we felt the quality was excellent. The felted wool on it surprisingly didn't attract dog hair, and it was very comfortable for him to run around in. It didn't irritate his armpits, and it was very lightweight and breathable. I highly recommend this store's products.
There are a lot of great products, but I feel like most of them are for small dogs.
nice!

A shop selling German-made dog and cat food and toys.

I'm not sure if it's thanks to the food from here, but my cat, who will be 14 years old in December 2025, is full of energy!
Best food in tokyo
I visited this store while browsing pet supply shops after getting a large dog, but the selection was small and the items were rather plain, so there was nothing for us to buy.
Great service and lovely shop
Dog jumping out

As someone wrote before, I bought a knit sweater and after only wearing it occasionally for two weeks, the stitching was poor and it started to tear.
I was planning to ask for repairs,
but they made me sound like I was a dishonest customer.
They only inspected it by taking it out of the bag.
Normally, you can prevent the threads from fraying by splitting them apart, but because this one is just threaded through, it comes undone. The stitching is in China.
I also bought a new harness at the same time, but the Velcro on this one stopped working after four months. Products were good before, but if they're not the best, they can be considered poor quality.
They didn't even check my purchase history.
I'm embarrassed to have recommended this product to others.
The store was a little smaller than I expected, but there were some rare items and I had a great time.

They sell dog accessories for small to large dogs, including leashes, collars, and rainwear. 
Unlike what you'd find at a home improvement store, you'll find high-quality items that you can use and love for a long time.
My dog ​​and cat both love using these products. They especially love the matching beanie and dog sweaters we bought this winter! 💕 …

The staff's service was perfect for me. They were able to order items from Germany that weren't in stock. I couldn't bring my toy poodle this time, so I'll definitely bring him next time.
Thank you for your continued support!
The store was playing jazz versions of Yoasobi music, indicating a refined taste. Recommended.

It was in a hard-to-find location; it was listed as Ginza 1-chome, but the nearest station seemed to be Kyobashi Station. I finally found it and went inside, but they didn't have what I was looking for.

The store had a limited selection of goods.
